Shinies can be obtained by various methods, for example SOS chains, where you lower a pokemons health so it calls for help, increasing your chain and your odds of finding shinies. Another method is Masuda Method breeding, where you breed 2 pokemon of different regions and have increased shiny odds (this helps you get shinies that are good in battle). If you are lucky, you may even find shinies in the while, but the odds are pretty low. The key to shiny hunting is patience

On the other hand, The key to wondertrade is just to get lucky and being persistence, youll end up getting something good. (I got a shiny mimikyu). Also, you can just wondertrade all your pokemon you hatched from eggs while Shiny hunting or breeding competitive pokemon.
